title: Delinquency and Inactivity Thresholds for Larkspur Credit Cards
content:
Collections thresholds are the same on every card in the Larkspur Credit Cards line-up. Each threshold is a count of days past due, except the inactivity period, which is counted in months.

| Threshold | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due at which charging privileges are suspended | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days past due at which the account is charged off | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Days past due at which delinquency is reported to the credit bureaus | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Months without any transaction, with a 0.00 balance, after which Larkspur may close the account | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |

## How the thresholds sit against one another

As an account's days past due rise, it reaches the thresholds in this order:

1. 30 days past due: delinquency is reported to the credit bureaus.
2. 60 days past due: charging privileges are suspended.
3. 180 days past due: the account is charged off.

The inactivity period is a separate measure. It counts months without any transaction on an account whose balance is 0.00, not days past due. After 24 such months Larkspur may close the account.
